title: XSS vulnerability via unescaped href in crossSellBanner
reasoning: The href attribute is directly populated from user-controlled config (opts.href or config.crossSell.href) without validation. An attacker could inject javascript: URLs to execute arbitrary JavaScript when users click the banner link. The feature is marked with trust boundary 'user-input' and this config flows from external sources without sanitization.
reproduction: Set moduleOptions['cross-sell-banner'].href to 'javascript:alert(document.cookie)' in portal config. When the banner renders and a user clicks it, arbitrary JavaScript executes in the portal context.
recommendation: Validate href against an allowlist of safe URL schemes (https://, http://, mailto:). Reject or sanitize javascript:, data:, and other dangerous schemes. Add a URL validation helper that checks new URL(href).protocol is in ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:'].
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this feature. No validation logic exists to prevent dangerous URL schemes in external configuration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Unit test: assert CrossSellBanner returns null or safe fallback when opts.href='javascript:alert(1)'. Integration test: verify config.crossSell.href with javascript: scheme is rejected or sanitized before render.
minimumFixScope: src/src/portal/modules/crossSellBanner.tsx lines 175-177: add URL scheme validation before using href
